method: Read all 48 issue bodies and all 21 existing comments, then compare ID/number/title/URL/state and acceptance scope with the immutable implementation ledger. Read-only GitHub calls; no workflow retries, issue mutations or product tests. This local report is the only new artifact.
comparisonBoundaries: The ledger mirrors ID, issue number, title, URL and state; it has no assignee or detailed acceptance-criteria fields. All live issues are unassigned, so no ownership conflict was observed.

The two live acceptance templates differ in wording. Issues 3–22 explicitly require committed acceptance evidence before closure; issues 23–50 use a shorter compatibility-suite closure sentence. Both require actual installed behavior, Codex discovery/call, deterministic positive/negative boundaries, bounded output/no secret logging, explicit platforms and linked roadmap evidence. Repository-wide committed-evidence requirements still apply.
All eight releaseChecks remain pending for full 26-tool/all-48-issue acceptance. Passing scoped configuration/platform jobs do not contradict those release-level pending states.

rows.title: [DCP-001] NPM-installable package and npx entry point
rows.gapScope: Package MTerm-CLI so a clean user can install/run it through npm tooling (registry, approved GitHub package, or npm-supported Git source) without cloning the development checkout. `npx`/installed bin must launch the MCP server from outside the repo. Verify packed allowlist, production dependencies, uninstall behavior, and no GUI/Electron dependency.
rows.ledgerObservation: Packed install, offline npm exec including actual MCP, and isolated link verified on Windows. Registry/Git-source distribution and full-platform lifecycle still open.

rows.title: [DCP-002] Idempotent Codex setup/registration command
rows.gapScope: Implement a real setup command that registers MTerm as a Codex stdio MCP server using supported Codex configuration mechanisms. Re-running setup must be idempotent and must preserve unrelated Codex config. Add isolated CODEX_HOME integration tests.
rows.ledgerObservation: Explicit managed setup is implemented and tested against real Codex0.160.1 plus installed package; platform/complete-contract qualification remains.

rows.title: [DCP-003] Codex remove/uninstall with backup and rollback
rows.gapScope: Implement removal of only MTerm-owned Codex configuration, with backup/conflict checks and rollback on failure. Never remove unrelated MCP servers or user settings.
rows.ledgerObservation: Exact owned removal with backups/idempotence/conflict protection tested; cooperative locking boundary and full-platform qualification remain.

rows.title: [DCP-004] Codex-managed background MCP lifecycle with no manual foreground server
rows.gapScope: Once configured, Codex must spawn and supervise MTerm automatically as an stdio MCP child, so the user does not manually keep a terminal window open. Verify startup, reconnect/relaunch after Codex restart, clean EOF shutdown, and no persistent daemon unless explicitly selected.
rows.ledgerObservation: Configuration parsed by actual Codex and2 SDK-managed registered-command lifecycles passed. Actual Codex agent tool session and platform acceptance remain unrun.

rows.title: [DCP-005] Private/GitHub-friendly install and update path
rows.gapScope: Provide a supported update/install path even if MTerm is not published to the public npm registry. Document and test immutable GitHub/tag/package installs and user-initiated updates without `git pull` against a user checkout.

rows.title: [DCP-006] Cross-platform npm/Codex install validation
rows.gapScope: Validate the install/setup/MCP lifecycle on Windows, macOS and Linux using supported Node/Codex versions. Keep unsupported architectures explicit until tested.
rows.ledgerObservation: Verified baseline main 059413ffa4fb3b18c8e15af907744a40e0b874a7 passed Windows2022, Ubuntu24.04, macOS14 ARM64 and macOS15 Intel normal build/check/package/pinned Codex gates in run41375692062 plus fast41375691964. This is foundation/platform evidence; all feature contracts and actual Codex agent acceptance remain open. New changes need their own exact-source checks.

rows.title: [DCP-007] DesktopCommander-compatible MCP tool names and schemas
rows.gapScope: Expose DesktopCommander-compatible tool names and argument/result semantics (or rigorously tested aliases) for Codex, while retaining any MTerm-native names internally. Compatibility must cover all published upstream MCP tools so existing Codex instructions do not need rewriting.
rows.ledgerObservation: Eight optional file/text aliases implemented and actually exercised through npm exec MCP. No stub tools. Full26-tool names/schemas/behavior remain incomplete.

rows.title: [DCP-008] Pinned upstream parity baseline and drift detector
rows.gapScope: Record the exact DesktopCommander parity baseline (version/commit/tool manifest) and add a review/check that detects upstream tool/schema changes. Updating the baseline must be explicit and regenerate the parity matrix/issues.
rows.ledgerObservation: Pinned manifest, schema and text-handler snapshots verified; drift probe does not advance target; false PASS/closure assertions rejected. Issue remains open pending full acceptance review.

rows.title: [DCP-009] Implement get_config MCP parity
rows.gapScope: Add `get_config` with effective blockedCommands, defaultShell, allowedDirectories, fileReadLineLimit, fileWriteLineLimit, telemetryEnabled, client/system information and any other published fields required by the pinned baseline.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending. DCP-009 candidate adds pinned five-field memory formatting, truthful OS/Node/process metadata, generic example paths, empty no-provider flags, bounded client identity and six-entry ordering. Explicit omitted Python/container/env/path fields and owner-bounded shell/editability differences keep full acceptance open. Direct RED/GREEN and config/retry regressions passed in scratch; native/full/installed/hosted candidate gates remain pending.

rows.title: [DCP-010] Implement set_config_value MCP parity
rows.gapScope: Add `set_config_value` for supported settings with validation, atomic persistence, safe error handling and runtime effect matching the pinned upstream semantics.
rows.ledgerObservation: Recovered six-setting implementation now tolerates bounded Windows EPERM/EBUSY for config/backup replacement, with expected bytes and owned-stage validation on every attempt. Native Windows focused38/38 passes. Exact upstream outputs/coercions/security differences and full installed/Codex acceptance remain open.

rows.title: [DCP-011] Support multiple allowedDirectories roots
rows.gapScope: Expand single-root policy to a safe multi-root allowedDirectories model. Canonical/reparse/symlink checks must apply independently to every root and must not weaken current protections.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending.

rows.title: [DCP-012] Implement configurable blockedCommands enforcement
rows.gapScope: Implement the DesktopCommander blockedCommands safety model and enforce it in command execution paths. Configuration changes must take effect safely and tests must cover bypass attempts.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending.

rows.title: [DCP-013] Implement defaultShell configuration
rows.gapScope: Support a configurable default shell matching DesktopCommander semantics on Windows/macOS/Linux and report it through config. Shell selection must be explicit and injection-safe.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending.

rows.title: [DCP-014] Implement configurable file read/write line limits
rows.gapScope: Implement fileReadLineLimit and fileWriteLineLimit semantics and dynamic validation. Tool pagination/defaults must follow config without unbounded output.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending.

rows.title: [DCP-015] Implement telemetryEnabled configuration semantics
rows.gapScope: Expose telemetryEnabled parity and ensure disabling it prevents telemetry emission. MTerm-specific telemetry must remain opt-in/transparent and never expose secrets.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; full platform/security/installed contract acceptance pending.

rows.title: [DCP-016] Dynamic cross-process config reload without server restart
rows.gapScope: Match DesktopCommander dynamic config behavior: supported config changes become visible to running MCP instances without requiring Codex restart, with safe cross-process watching/coordination and deterministic tests.
rows.ledgerObservation: Preserved unpublished owner-bounded compatibility configuration recovered with tests. Snapshot reload, multi-root ceilings, blocked executable names, limits and telemetry preference implemented; complete pinned-contract and actual Codex-client acceptance pending. Qualification checkpoint (2026-11-02): Standalone native Windows installed probe passed seven scenarios with two concurrent MCP processes and a restart: live limits/roots/blocks, distinct-key writes, corruption denial and owned cleanup. The revised integrated Windows workflow subsequently passed 164/164 tests, normal package, self-host, normal prepack and source/installed managed-Codex gates. Implementation def85d2 subsequently passed all nine exact-head checks across Windows, Linux and both macOS architectures, plus a clean committed extraction with normal prepack and installed package validation. Full issue acceptance is not awarded.

rows.title: [DCP-017] read_file negative offset / tail semantics
rows.gapScope: Extend read_file to support DesktopCommander-style negative offsets for reading from the end of a file, with bounded line semantics and tests for short/large/Unicode files.
rows.ledgerObservation: 36 differential text offset/tail cases match pinned TextFileHandler. Large-file/encoding/format/limits qualification still open.

rows.title: [DCP-018] read_file URL support
rows.gapScope: Implement the pinned upstream `isUrl` behavior for safe URL reads, with protocol allowlists, size/time limits, redirect policy, SSRF protections and deterministic fixtures.

rows.title: [DCP-019] read_multiple_files tool parity
rows.gapScope: Add `read_multiple_files` with per-file errors, bounded aggregate output, root policy enforcement and format handling consistent with individual reads.
rows.ledgerObservation: Bounded text multi-file partial-error handling implemented. Image/document payloads not supported.

rows.title: [DCP-020] write_file append mode parity
rows.gapScope: Add `mode: append` semantics in addition to rewrite, with concurrency/version behavior that cannot silently corrupt content. Preserve safe atomic behavior where applicable.
rows.ledgerObservation: Text append/rewrite/missing-target behavior and BOM preservation implemented. Dynamic configured limits/office behavior still missing.

rows.title: [DCP-021] create_directory nested-path parity
rows.gapScope: Match DesktopCommander create_directory behavior for nested directory creation and existing-directory cases while enforcing allowed roots and link safety.
rows.ledgerObservation: Nested directory creation idempotent with whole-path prevalidation tested. All-platform/security parity remains open.

rows.title: [DCP-022] Recursive list_directory depth parity
rows.gapScope: Implement recursive directory listing with configurable depth and context/output protection, while preserving hidden/private policy and deterministic truncation metadata.
rows.ledgerObservation: Bounded recursive depth listing implemented; top-level/overflow/error semantics differ from upstream and require resolution.

rows.title: [DCP-023] move_file files/directories and cross-filesystem parity
rows.gapScope: Extend move_file beyond current regular-file-only same-filesystem behavior to the pinned upstream contract, including directories, collision rules and safe cross-device fallback.
rows.ledgerObservation: Regular-file same-filesystem no-overwrite move only. Directories and cross-device parity remain open.

rows.title: [DCP-024] get_file_info complete metadata parity
rows.gapScope: Expand metadata to the pinned DesktopCommander result: type, size, timestamps, permissions/attributes and other published fields, with cross-platform normalization.
rows.ledgerObservation: Text/stat metadata implemented; spreadsheet/document metadata and complete platform behavior remain open.

rows.title: [DCP-025] edit_block surgical text replacement parity
rows.gapScope: Implement edit_block text replacement with old_string/new_string, expected_replacements, exact ambiguity errors, line-ending preservation and safe atomic writes.
rows.ledgerObservation: Exact replacement with required occurrence count implemented; fuzzy diagnostics, normalized/office matching remain open.

rows.title: [DCP-026] Native Excel read/write/edit/search parity
rows.gapScope: Support .xlsx/.xls/.xlsm operations exposed by DesktopCommander: read sheets/ranges, write/edit cells/ranges and search workbook content with bounded output and formula/value fidelity.

rows.title: [DCP-027] PDF read/create/modify parity
rows.gapScope: Support PDF text extraction in read_file plus write_pdf creation and insert/delete modification operations, with bounded parsing/rendering and deterministic tests.

rows.title: [DCP-028] DOCX read/create/edit/search parity
rows.gapScope: Support DOCX reading, creation, surgical XML/range editing and searching as exposed by DesktopCommander, preserving document integrity and bounded outputs.

rows.title: [DCP-029] Asynchronous start_search session model
rows.gapScope: Replace/augment synchronous search with DesktopCommander-compatible start_search sessions that return session IDs and continue safely for large searches.

rows.title: [DCP-030] get_more_search_results pagination
rows.gapScope: Implement result paging by search session ID with offset/length semantics and stable ordering, without losing unread results.

rows.title: [DCP-031] stop_search cancellation
rows.gapScope: Implement explicit cancellation of an owned search session and prove underlying ripgrep/search work is terminated promptly without affecting other sessions.

rows.title: [DCP-032] list_searches session inventory
rows.gapScope: Expose active/completed search session metadata needed for recovery and context continuation, with bounded retention.

rows.title: [DCP-033] Ripgrep search options parity
rows.gapScope: Match start_search options: files/content mode, regex vs literal, filePattern, ignoreCase, includeHidden, contextLines, timeout, maxResults, earlyTermination, and vscode-ripgrep-backed large-repo behavior.

rows.title: [DCP-034] start_process shell/default-shell command parity
rows.gapScope: Support DesktopCommander-style command strings and explicit/default shell selection in addition to MTerm's structured executable mode, while retaining injection/safety controls and blockedCommands enforcement.

rows.title: [DCP-035] start_process timeout/background/readiness detection
rows.gapScope: Match DesktopCommander process launch semantics for timeout_ms, background execution and smart readiness/input detection; define running vs completed without blocking Codex.

rows.title: [DCP-036] interact_with_process wait-for-prompt semantics
rows.gapScope: Extend process input to support timeout_ms, wait_for_prompt and response collection semantics used for interactive shells/REPLs.

rows.title: [DCP-037] read_process_output line pagination and tail semantics
rows.gapScope: Match pid/offset/length/timeout output reads, including negative tail offsets and completed-session reads, while preserving bounded UTF-8-safe output.

rows.title: [DCP-038] force_terminate parity
rows.gapScope: Expose force_terminate semantics for a managed terminal session, including descendant cleanup and honest platform-specific guarantees.

rows.title: [DCP-039] list_sessions metadata and completed-session retention
rows.gapScope: Match DesktopCommander session inventory fields/lifecycle so Codex can recover running/completed long-lived terminal work after context switches.

rows.title: [DCP-040] System-wide list_processes tool parity
rows.gapScope: Add read-only system process enumeration equivalent to DesktopCommander's list_processes, with bounded output and platform-specific fields.

rows.title: [DCP-041] System-wide kill_process tool parity
rows.gapScope: Add kill_process for explicitly selected OS processes with clear safety rules, failure modes and platform behavior; do not confuse this with MTerm-owned session termination.

rows.title: [DCP-042] Interactive PTY/REPL fidelity for SSH, databases and dev servers
rows.gapScope: Provide interactive process behavior sufficient for SSH, Python/Node/R REPLs, database shells and development servers, including prompts, Unicode and terminal semantics expected by DesktopCommander.

rows.title: [DCP-043] Terminal output encoding and null-byte parity
rows.gapScope: Handle Windows/PowerShell UTF-16 plus null-byte and mixed-encoding output edge cases covered by DesktopCommander tests without corrupting output or MCP framing.

rows.title: [DCP-044] get_usage_stats tool parity
rows.gapScope: Implement get_usage_stats with local tool/performance usage metrics and privacy controls matching the pinned upstream behavior; keep this separate from Codex account quota.

rows.title: [DCP-045] Persistent get_recent_tool_calls history parity
rows.gapScope: Persist bounded recent MCP tool history including tool name, arguments and bounded output previews, with filtering by count/tool/time and no credential leakage.

rows.title: [DCP-046] Tool history rotation and trimming
rows.gapScope: Add size/count-based rotation/trimming for persisted tool history so history survives restarts but cannot grow without bound.

rows.title: [DCP-047] give_feedback_to_desktop_commander compatibility behavior
rows.gapScope: Provide a compatibility implementation or documented MTerm-equivalent for the published feedback tool so the advertised Codex tool surface is complete without impersonating upstream telemetry.

rows.title: [DCP-048] get_prompts / onboarding prompt parity
rows.gapScope: Expose the published get_prompts behavior and bundled onboarding/help prompt data needed by Codex-facing parity, with versioned local resources and no hidden network dependency.
